// Re-verified live 2026-07 via kegg_hexokinase_verify_debug.py: the
// SUBSTRATE field below ("ATP [CPD:C00002]; D-hexose [CPD:C00738]") is
// byte-for-byte identical to a fresh live fetch of
// https://rest.kegg.jp/get/ec:2.7.1.1 - confirmed real, not assumed.
//
// Every other field below (NAME, REACTION, ALL_REAC, PRODUCT, COMMENT,
// PATHWAY, GENES, DBLINKS) IS stale relative to live KEGG, same as the
// LDH fixture and for the same reason: KEGG continuously adds newly
// sequenced genomes (live GENES now lists ~1400+ lines vs. this
// fixture's single human line) and accumulates more cross-references,
// literature citations, and pathway links over time. None of those
// fields are read by parse_kegg_substrates() (which only extracts the
// SUBSTRATE block), so this fixture is kept abbreviated to the fields
// that were real at capture time and re-confirmed real for the one
// field this codebase actually parses - not reproducing ~1400 lines
// with zero effect on what's tested.
ENTRY       EC 2.7.1.1                 Enzyme
NAME        hexokinase;
            hexokinase type IV;
            glucokinase
CLASS       Transferases;
            Transferring phosphorus-containing groups;
            Phosphotransferases with an alcohol group as acceptor
SYSNAME     ATP:D-hexose 6-phosphotransferase
REACTION    ATP + D-hexose = ADP + D-hexose 6-phosphate [RN:R01786]
ALL_REAC    R01786
SUBSTRATE   ATP [CPD:C00002];
            D-hexose [CPD:C00738]
PRODUCT     ADP [CPD:C00008];
            D-hexose 6-phosphate [CPD:C01209]
COMMENT     Wide specificity for hexoses.
PATHWAY     ec00010  Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis
ORTHOLOGY   K00844  hexokinase
GENES       HSA: 3098(HK1) 3099(HK2) 3101(HK3)
DBLINKS     ExplorEnz - The Enzyme Database: 2.7.1.1
